premise: Quintessence Cycle 1 vertical slice: a tarot reader satisfies three Querents (Curious, Troubled, Fated) by laying Minor Arcana into a Three-Card Spread. Score = Light x Gravity. Majors are collectible Arcana. Android portrait, touch.
actions: Tap a hand card to lay it in the first open position, or drag it onto a position
Tap a laid card to return it to hand
RESHUFFLE: mark hand cards, confirm to redraw

loop.goal: Reach each Querent's Insight target within 4 Readings; clear the Fated Querent to finish Cycle 1
loop.failure_or_pressure: Readings run out below target: run ends. Shadow (Troubled/Fated) previews and then Eclipses one position. Fated rule The Twin halves suits already used this Night.
loop.restart: New Reading button on defeat/victory starts a fresh seeded run in one tap

mechanics.name: Reading detection
mechanics.rule: Royal-less 3-card version of design table: Glimpse (no pattern), Echo (pair), Path (3 consecutive ranks), Triad, Harmony (3 same suit; design says 4+, reduced for Three-Card Spread), Court Assembly (3 courts), River (Path + one suit). Best match wins.

mechanics.name: Positions
mechanics.rule: Past: card Light counts twice. Present: +2 Gravity (+3 if Court). Future: card Light halved, card returns to hand after the Reading.

mechanics.name: Score
mechanics.rule: Insight = Light x Gravity. Light = reading base + card ranks (+position, Arcana). Gravity = reading base + position + Arcana. Fate fixed at 1 in Cycle 1.

mechanics.name: Shadow Eclipse
mechanics.rule: Troubled/Fated only. After Readings 1 and 3, the Shadow marks one position; on the next Reading it is blocked. Max 1 intent per turn (v1.1 cap).

mechanics.name: Economy
mechanics.rule: Start 4 coins. Win: Curious 3 / Troubled 4 / Fated 5 + 1 per unused Reading + interest 1 per 5 held (max 5). Market: 2 Majors (6), 2 Minor cards (3), 1 Sigil (3), reroll 2. Sell Major for 3.

mechanics.name: Arcana (slice pool)
mechanics.rule: Empress, Lovers, Hermit, Star, Sun, Tower, Emperor-lite excluded (depends on locked Dignities). 5 slots.

invariants: Deck conservation: hand + spread + draw + discard + destroyed = 56 + bought
Each Reading consumes exactly one Reading; Read rejected with 0 cards or while animating
Reshuffle consumes exactly one Reshuffle and returns exactly the marked count
Score preview equals the scored result for the same placement
A Major exists at most once per run
Coins never negative; purchase rejected when unaffordable or slots full
Restart resets all state, tweens and particles
assumptions: Targets are first-pass tuning, to be playtested
Skip/Signs, Wagers, Debt, orientation, Dignities, Thread, Quintessence are out of scope for Cycle 1 (unlock schedule in design v1.1)
Targets 600/900/1200 set from bot data: a full-search greedy bot (no reshuffles) clears Cycle I in ~95% of runs; humans will be weaker. Needs playtesting.
